name: CoolerControl
summary: Fan curves for your CPU, case fans, liquid cooler and graphics card, set from a web page.
caveats: When it stops or you remove it, the motherboard and graphics card fans it controlled go back to their firmware settings. USB coolers keep their last profile until the PC turns off.
Some motherboard fan chips and the graphics card's fan curve need an option below, which takes a restart.

copy.install: CoolerControl runs as a system service with full control of your fans, pump and GPU fan. Sign in to it with your VaporOS password.
copy.remove: Motherboard and graphics card fans go back to their firmware settings. USB coolers keep their last profile until the PC turns off. Its profiles stay unless you also delete its settings.

settings.label: Graphics card fan curve
settings.help: Lets CoolerControl set an AMD card's fan curve. This turns on the card's overclocking controls, so a wrong setting there can make the card unstable.

settings.label: Motherboard fan chip (it87)
settings.help: Makes fans on some ITE chips show up. The chip is then shared with the board's firmware, which may rarely read wrong sensor values.
